hypothesis: Replace repeated frozenset subset checks in executable dominance with arbitrary-precision integer bitmask subset checks, while preserving the exact set membership and executable-cost predicate.

implementation.stable_mapping: Per-search monotonic identifier-to-bit map; each newly encountered string ID is assigned the next bit and never renumbered.
implementation.direct_macro_attribute: Convert state_used tuple to integer mask at state registration.
implementation.executable_lineage_attribute: Convert the exact executable_lineage_ids result to integer mask at state registration.
implementation.dominance_subset_equivalent: (right_mask & ~left_mask) == 0 is used in place of right_set.issubset(left_set).
implementation.expanded_execution_cost: Uses the same executable_cost(expr) function, unchanged.
implementation.decision_trace: When ACSIE_SEARCH_TRACE_DIGEST=1, masks decode back to the canonical sorted ID lists used by D/E trace schema. This decoding is skipped when tracing is disabled.
implementation.search_control: No candidate-generation, target cutoff, rank-order, frontier-admission, or dominance-objective changes intended.

checkpoint.caveat: State continuation from the memoized B lab checkpoint; not a byte-identical original process replay.

safety_note: F is an isolated proving-ground snapshot, not production ACSIE source.
